items.title: Wrong-turn alert
items.what: When you follow a saved walk and stray more than 60 m off it, the phone buzzes, the coach tells you, and a red banner and dashed line on the map point you back to the track.
items.where: Pick a walk, tap 'Walk this route', then GO (shows on the recording screen)
items.inspiredBy: AllTrails wrong-turn alerts and Strava off-route alerts

items.title: Race the gold medal
items.what: While walking a saved route, a live line shows how many seconds you're ahead of or behind the gold medal holder's pace, and the km voice updates say it too.
items.where: Pick a walk, tap 'Walk this route', then GO (under the green progress bar)
